main.description: One vote on a subatomic post or comment. rkey is deterministic per (voter, subject) — see public/lib/oauth.js's voteRkey — so casting a new vote on the same subject overwrites this record rather than creating a second one, and deleting it withdraws the vote entirely. Written to the voter's own repo; src/index.ts's /api/vote and /api/unvote read it back (or confirm its absence) before applying it to the shared score at https://subatomic.bisks.net.

subject.description: The at-uri of the net.bisks.subatomic.post being voted on.

createdAt.description: When this vote was cast (or last changed), as an ISO 8601 datetime.
